propositions: Existing plan-review attestations remain valid after upstream direct children or prerequisites change their plans, allowing agents to close work using outdated assumptions.
New plan reviews must record signed material fingerprint pins for direct children and prerequisites, binding each related ticket's canonical ID, role, and current fingerprint.

Enforcement of material-pin drift invalidates downstream attestations only when a pinned target's material actually changes; older readers must ignore additive pin lines without invalidating signatures.
A unified pre-sign transaction must collect all relationship and fingerprint state outside the write lock, verify equality under the store lock, and abort if any concurrent change occurs.
Ticket review phase transitions to execution only on STATUS entry to in_progress and resets to planning on any transition to open, persisted in compiled state and preserved through compaction.
Close operations with enforce_plan_material_pins and require_plan_review_for_close enabled must require a current compatible plan review; code freshness alone never invalidates the review.
